facts.claim: User hook files are any *.json in ~/.copilot/hooks/ (or $COPILOT_HOME/hooks/); an inline hooks block at the top level of ~/.copilot/settings.json also loads; all sources are combined, none replaces another
File shape {version:1, disableAllHooks?, hooks:{preToolUse:[{type:'command', matcher?, bash|powershell|command|exec+args, cwd?, env?, timeoutSec?|timeout?}]}}; timeouts in seconds, default 30
Matcher is a regex anchored ^(?:PATTERN)$ on toolName for camelCase preToolUse; PascalCase PreToolUse uses Claude matcher semantics and Claude tool names (Bash for bash/powershell)
A malformed item in a hooks-directory file is dropped alone; invalid JSON or a bad version rejects the file; inline settings.json hooks are strict (one bad item rejects the whole hooks field)
preToolUse command hooks fail closed on crash and any non-zero exit (other non-zero: 'Denied by preToolUse hook (hook errored)'); timeouts always fail open, even for policy hooks
Empty stdout or stdout that does not parse as one JSON object (after stripping progress lines) means no output and default behaviour; two JSON objects concatenated are ignored
Reply fields are top-level: permissionDecision allow|deny|ask, permissionDecisionReason, modifiedArgs (input rewrite). ask is denied in autopilot mode and under cloud agent

permissionRequest fires before the permission service; behavior allow|deny short-circuits it; message is the reason; interrupt:true with deny stops the agent entirely (ends the run); exit 2 is a deny; a sandbox-bypass request cannot be pre-approved by allow
Shell tool names bash (Unix) and powershell (Windows)
MCP tool name form in hook payloads (earlier notes: <server>-<tool>) is not documented in the hooks reference or CLI reference, and could not be checked in the binary
